articles.title: GPT-5.2 derives a new result in theoretical physics

concepts_taught.name: Application of LLMs in theoretical physics
Collaboration between AI models and human researchers

learning_outcomes: Understand how large language models can contribute to theoretical physics research
Recognize the potential for AI models to propose new formulas and hypotheses
Appreciate the importance of human-AI collaboration in scientific discovery
strategic_questions: What are the implications of AI models deriving new results in theoretical physics for the scientific community?
How can we ensure the validity and reliability of results proposed by AI models in scientific research?
What are the potential applications of LLMs in other fields of scientific research?

concepts_taught.name: Using LLMs for qualitative to quantitative data conversion

prerequisites.name: Basic understanding of natural language processing

learning_outcomes: Understand how to leverage LLMs for social science research
Learn about the potential of GABRIEL for scaling qualitative research
Recognize the benefits of converting qualitative data to quantitative data
strategic_questions: How can LLMs be used to improve the accuracy of social science research?
What are the potential limitations of using GPT for qualitative to quantitative data conversion?
How can researchers ensure the reliability of LLM-generated quantitative data?
